strings.configdndmedia: Offer to create a Text and media area when media files are dragged and dropped onto a course.
strings.configdndresizeheight: When a Text and media area is created from a dragged and dropped media file, resize it if it is higher than this many pixels. If set to zero, the media file will not be resized.
strings.configdndresizewidth: When a Text and media area is created from a dragged and dropped media file, resize it if it is wider than this many pixels. If set to zero, the media file will not be resized.
strings.dnduploadlabeltext: Add a Text and media area to the course page
strings.indicator:cognitivedepth_help: This indicator is based on the cognitive depth reached by the student in a Text and media area resource.
strings.indicator:cognitivedepthdef_help: The participant has reached this percentage of the cognitive engagement offered by the Text and media area resources during this analysis interval (Levels = No view, View)
strings.indicator:socialbreadth_help: This indicator is based on the social breadth reached by the student in a Text and media area resource.
strings.indicator:socialbreadthdef_help: The participant has reached this percentage of the social engagement offered by the Text and media area resources during this analysis interval (Levels = No participation, Participant alone)
strings.label:addinstance: Add a new Text and media area
strings.labelname_help: The title is only used to identify the Text and media area in the course index and for activity completion. If you leave it empty,  a title will be automatically generated using the first characters of the text.
strings.modulename_help:
The Text and media area enables you to display text and multimedia on the course page.

You can use a Text and media area to:

* Split up a long list of course activities with a subheading or an image
* Display an embedded video directly on the course page
* Add a short description to a course section
strings.privacy:metadata: The Text and media area plugin does not store any personal data.
